scope: Recipe construction and offline integration checks only; lane:foundation; no host installation, image layer pull, service start, live DB access or model invocation.

selection.reason: User-selected maintained upstream orchestration runtime; native task delegation, embedded client, production Compose topology, SKILL.md discovery and context controls are present at this revision. No measured superiority or adoption claim is made.

research_workflow.research_delegation: Read-only researcher reviewed primary sources; coordinator independently checked critical source, image metadata and configuration claims. No additional writing worktree or worker was created.
research_workflow.discovery: Installed skill catalog and skills registry used as leads; upstream skills/public/claude-to-deerflow/SKILL.md verified at the selected commit. Existing adopted skills remain the selection; no skill was installed.
capability_check_order: Installed runtime: intentionally not installed or executed under the recipe-only scope; native acceptance remains pending.
Release tag and release notes: v2.1.0 resolved through GitHub metadata.
Pinned source: verified codeload bytes, lockfiles, configuration classes, supported extension seams and native execution/test commands.
Official documentation: pinned README and backend docs, QMD source, SQLite/Python documentation.
research_workflow.retrieval: Web content fetched/indexed with Context Mode and queried in its index; large source extraction printed derived answers only. Known-source local reads used the verified archive.
retrieval_limitations: A shell network attempt failed DNS; Context Mode retrieval was available.
One release-API retrieval returned 403; researcher used gh API fallback.
No native runtime diagnostic was attempted; absence statements are scoped to inspected source.

sources.headers: pins.json#/header_reference: langchain-openai 1.2.1 verified sdist, chat_models/base.py:783,1385-1411,1683-1712,3327-3345; gateway-owner measured request contract supplied by the user on 2026-09-27

decisions.action: Install official release images by digest with the production Compose topology.
decisions.alternatives: Native make install/make dev and development Compose are upstream-supported. Native installation alters Git hooks and the host dependency environment; development Compose syncs at startup. Those are not selected.

decisions.action: Run LocalSandboxProvider inside the dedicated backend container; mount no Docker socket.
decisions.alternatives: AIO DooD exposes the rootless daemon to the backend. The reviewed AIO selection chooses a Kubernetes provisioner or local Docker manager; no static base_url connector was found there. Native AIO, Kubernetes, E2B and OpenSandbox require separate host choices.
decisions.limitation: Trusted single-user code shares the backend process/container and mounts; thread paths are not process isolation.

decisions.action: Use native summarization, tool-output externalization, token budgets and bounded task delegation.
decisions.limitation: No token or cost savings measured. Headroom is omitted because native offload covers the requested gap.

decisions.action: Wrap only the pinned ChatOpenAI payload hook to supply per-call idempotency and stable conversation affinity headers.
decisions.limitation: Private LangChain hook must be requalified on upgrade. Actual Responses/max/cache/header behavior is a host gate.

decisions.action: Implement tool schema/execution restrictions through the supported AuthorizationProvider interface.
decisions.limitation: Codex enabled_tools/disabled_tools keys are not implemented by the inspected MCP connection builder. Allowed bash/ctx_execute remains arbitrary code; this is not a process security boundary.

decisions.action: Launch adopted stdio MCP commands inside the backend using narrow read-only host dependency mounts and a cwd wrapper.
decisions.limitation: Host registrations alone are insufficient. Binary/interpreter dependencies and ABI compatibility must pass host preflight.

decisions.action: Create an owned writable QMD SQLite backup of exactly four nonempty adopted collections; permit lexical query and collection-qualified reads.
decisions.limitation: No shared index refresh or model download; snapshot freshness and permitted source database must be supplied privately.

decisions.action: Verify adopted SKILL.md hashes and symlink adopted/public skills by reference.
decisions.limitation: Per-user global custom fallback stops after interactive user custom skills exist; dedicated-user visibility remains a host check.

decisions.action: Drive the unchanged embedded client for a frozen research-plus-code task; separately execute the deterministic verifier and sanitize native/SQL observations.
decisions.limitation: Local oracle fixtures do not establish DeerFlow acceptance; gateway rows cover a window and cannot uniquely attribute concurrent traffic.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Guessed sandbox.bash_timeout rather than the upstream field.
anti_pattern_log.proof: Pinned SandboxConfig and config.example.yaml specify bash_command_timeout.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Use bash_command_timeout and assert absence of the wrong key.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Collected artifacts without the effective user scope.
anti_pattern_log.proof: Pinned Paths.sandbox_outputs_dir and runtime user_context require the user-specific path.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Counted every task tool return as child completion.
anti_pattern_log.proof: Pinned status_contract.py and synthetic native event reproduction distinguish completion, failure and timeout.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Count only subagent_status=completed; keep every native failure status including error-prefixed and empty results.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Allowed a later tool tuple event to discard richer values-event status.
anti_pattern_log.proof: client.py serializes additional_kwargs in values events but omits them in tool tuple events.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Merge returned message fields by tool call identity.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Redis image entrypoint would chown the owned bind and a loopback probe would miss an interface-only listener.
anti_pattern_log.proof: Upstream Redis image entrypoint and the draft listener/healthcheck disagreed.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Use a bounded entrypoint retaining rootless user ownership and probe the explicit container interface.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Mounted the native QMD cache read-only although query startup needs writes.
anti_pattern_log.proof: QMD v2.8.3 store.ts opens/initializes SQLite state.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Read the adopted source with mode=ro, seed with SQLite backup, and query owned writable state; preserve adopted Node PATH for addon ABI.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Placed raw trace evidence in a writable worker mount.
anti_pattern_log.proof: Draft container mounts exposed the intended observation path.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Host captures stdout outside worker mounts; oracle also runs separately.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Only framework container cleanup was guaranteed after interruption.
anti_pattern_log.proof: Draft checker timeout left its named process outside the cleanup path.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Both exact owned names are cleaned in finally blocks; unknown cleanup fails the gate.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Used a SQLite transaction context without closing the connection.
anti_pattern_log.proof: An offline suite returned ResourceWarnings for unclosed connections.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Wrap all scoped SQLite handles in contextlib.closing.

anti_pattern_log.proof: Source AST reported unknown top-level tracing; tracing_config.py:143-169 reads provider environment flags. Contract test failed before correction.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Remove the unsupported section and set the three native tracing flags to false.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Assumed DEER_FLOW_HOME also controls the SQLite database directory.
anti_pattern_log.proof: database_config.py:259-268 resolves sqlite_dir from cwd; AppConfig defaults to .deer-flow/data.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Explicit database.sqlite_dir environment reference uses owned application state and fresh per-attempt E2E state.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: The receipt reader normalized numeric text timestamps only after an SQL predicate that excluded them.
anti_pattern_log.proof: Synthetic gateway-reader test returned two rows instead of the four in-window representations.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Normalize nonnegative epoch text in the SQL window predicate before filtering; ISO and numeric formats remain supported.

anti_pattern_log.mistake: Carried an unused BETTER_AUTH_SECRET key and default frontend origins into the draft.
anti_pattern_log.proof: At this pin gateway auth/config.py persists a JWT secret under DEER_FLOW_HOME, while frontend gateway-config.ts defaults its proxy origin list to localhost:3000.
anti_pattern_log.correction: Remove the unused secret, retain native JWT persistence, and configure DEER_FLOW_TRUSTED_ORIGINS for the actual loopback nginx URL.

anti_pattern_log_scope: Corrections retained here because the shared docs/harness-defaults.md log is outside this builder file ownership. Coordinator may link or integrate this record.
